items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: Charley had this Matty (Hight) and Mary Stafford... She worked with Eubie Blake for awhile.

ctx.x: Uh hunh. Well, that Big Apple was still there, on the same corner, 135th and Seventh. Right.

But I don't remember that statement, but I know they came there. Many of them came. But, when we got the word in Atlantic City, Charley had this Matty (Hight) and Mary Stafford, and this other girl I'm talking about. She was a very good singer. She worked with Eubie Blake for awhile. Was also -- was Mabel Richardson. She was from Washington, or down that way. Baltimore and Washington had some terrific girl singers. And a lot of the banjo and guitar players come from there. Washington had good tap dancers. That's…
Okay, so you came to New York and you started working at Baron Wilkins. What was your band at this point. Did you have Charley Gaines with you?
